title: Air Affinity Charm +CURIOS
description: Air Affinity, Let's you mine blocks normally while flying. Now wit CURIOS
body:
Air Affinity Charm Get rid of that obnoxious fatigue when having creative flight enabled in survival!  The Charm works from anywhere in the inventory.   Features: Block Break Speed while in air multiplied by 5, to negotiate the 5x penalty by vanilla. Or let's just say you can mine blocks when flying without any fatigue.   Recipe:

The Charm is crafted with  2 Feathers, 4 Diamonds and 1 gold Ingot. UPDATE: SEPERATE FILE DOWNLOAD - 1.0.0 CURIOS Support - Charm now only works when worn in a charm slot!   DISCLAIMER: !!!THIS MOD DOES **NOT** ADD A FLY COMMAND OR FLY ITEM!!! !!!TO BE USED WITH OTHER MODS THAT ENABLE FLIGHT!!! *** ## **Support the work** If you enjoy what I create, supporting the page helps me spend more time on updates, polishing features, fixing issues, and creating new content for future releases. Every bit of support helps keep development going — thank you for making the next update possible.   [![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1256117/description_64c320a5-8d4b-4911-97d9-ae44570af17c.png)](https://www.patreon.com/Azturax)
